title: Maturation of social adaptation circuits from ontogeny to pathology
title_zh: 社会适应回路的成熟：从发生发展到病理
abstract: From birth to adulthood, the social environment is highly dynamic; an individual faces specific social situations based on its developmental needs and those of its social group. Transitioning from one stage of development to another requires adjustment of social behaviors. Our knowledge of the mechanisms underlying these behavioral changes at each developmental stage is incomplete. Yet, it is a critical information to understand how social pathology can arise, especially as many disorders marked by social deficits emerge prior to adulthood. Here, we review some of the mechanisms that have been recently highlighted based on rodent models. We also discuss how disruptions of these processes can produce pathological social trajectories. Our overall goals are to highlight the dynamic nature of social behaviors across early life, the complex mechanisms that underly these changes, and the importance of distinct developmental stages as critical steeping stones toward an adult social phenotype that enables successful navigation of the challenges of an adult life.
abstract_zh: 从出生到成年，社会环境高度动态，个体基于其发展需要和所处群体需求面临特定社会情境。发育阶段之间的转换需要调整社会行为。我们对每个发育阶段行为变化背后的机制了解仍不完整，但这对理解社会性病理如何产生至关重要，尤其因为许多以社会缺陷为核心的障碍在成年前即出现。本文综述了基于啮齿动物模型近期强调的一些机制，并讨论这些过程受扰后如何形成病理性社会轨迹。我们总体目标在于强调早期生命阶段社会行为的动态性、驱动这些变化的复杂机制，以及不同发育阶段作为通向成人社会表型的关键“垫脚石”，其有助于成功应对成年生活中的挑战。
